# Site Architecture

The Smart Attendance System is an automated attendance tracking platform utilizing advanced AI-powered face recognition technology.

## Core Pages
- /: Home page - Welcome to the Smart Attendance System. Provides project overview and quick links.
- /setup-wizard: Setup wizard for first-time configuration of the application.

## Application SPA Routes
- /dashboard: User dashboard - Access attendance records, system stats, and manage users. Protected route.
- /login: User login - Dashboard Login. Authenticates users for protected routes.
- /mark-attendance: Mark attendance in the SPA. Captures face image and marks attendance.
- /attendance: View attendance in the SPA. View detailed attendance records.
- /session: Active attendance session in the SPA. Monitor live recognition events.
- /add-photos: Add user photos in the SPA. Capture and register photos for employees.
- /employees/register: Register a new employee in the SPA. Register basic details of a new employee.
- /train: Train facial recognition models. Trigger model retraining after adding new photos.

## Documentation
- /docs: Technical documentation covering system architecture, API, and setup.

## Admin & Dashboards
- /admin/evaluation/: Admin evaluation dashboard for model performance evaluation.
- /admin/ablation/: Admin ablation results for facial recognition pipeline.
- /admin/failures/: Admin failure analysis dashboard for failed recognitions.
- /admin/health/: Admin system health monitoring dashboard.
- /admin/attendance-dashboard/: Admin attendance dashboard overview.
- /admin/attendance-dashboard/export/: Admin attendance export to CSV/Excel.
- /admin/fairness/: Admin fairness dashboard analyzing demographic bias.
- /admin/recognition-trends/: Admin recognition accuracy trends over time.
- /admin/threshold-profiles/: Admin threshold profiles management.
- /admin/threshold-profiles/create/: Admin threshold profile create form.
- /admin/threshold-profiles/import/: Admin threshold profile import tool.
- /django-admin/: Django Admin Interface for raw database access.

## API Endpoints
- /api/threshold/: Threshold profile API. Manage distance threshold profiles.
- /api/v1/auth/login/: Auth Login API. Returns JWT tokens.
- /api/v1/auth/refresh/: Auth Refresh API. Refreshes JWT tokens.
- /api/v1/auth/verify/: Auth Verify API. Verifies JWT token validity.
- /api/v1/users/: Users API. CRUD operations for users.
- /api/v1/attendance/: Attendance API. CRUD operations for attendance records.
- /monitoring/metrics/: Monitoring metrics API for Prometheus.
